study.name: H11: 384px PV Diagnostic — Image N=5
study.description:
5 image-track proposer passes at T=0.7 on the full 384px evaluation area
(611 tiles). Post-hoc consensus sweep at all thresholds (1-of-5 through
5-of-5), each fed through the PV pipeline. Tests whether modality matters
at 384px under consensus + PV.
